newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Kia Group targets 17.5 pct sales rise.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Kia Group targets 17.5 pct sales rise.

text.p: South Korea's Kia Group said on Thursday it has targeted group sales next year at 14.1 trillion won, up 17.5 percent from an estimated 12 trillion won for calendar 1996.
Kia Motors Corp, one of South Korea's three largest car makers, is the flagship of the group which also has 15 other units.
No breakdown was given for individual company sales forecasts.
The group plans to expand investment, including research and development spending, by 13.9 percent to 780 billion won in calendar 1997, a Kia statement said.
